case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment's caption (S.P.S. Rathore v. C.B.I. & Anr.).

number_of_accused.reason: Single appellant-accused, S.P.S. Rathore, whose conviction the Court decides.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to throughout with male pronouns, such as 'he' and 'his'.

accused_age.reason: Judgment mentions only 'very advanced age' and 'old age', with no stated number.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states he was on deputation as Director (Vigilance & Security), BBMB, and was an IG of Police.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class; only 'past meritorious service' is mentioned.

previous_criminal_record.reason: The judgment does not mention any prior criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is a female minor throughout.

victim_age.reason: Judgment states both girls were 'aged about 15 years'.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused was HLTA president, a frequent visitor to the court, and summoned the victim to his office, which supports acquaintance.

offence_category.reason: Offence is outraging modesty under s.354 IPC, which fits Sexual assault.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charge-sheet under s.354; FIR cited ss.354 and 509; s.306 addition was set aside by the High Court.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness testimony, corroborating witnesses, Memorandum, handwriting expert and enquiry statements are all discussed.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Court notes the accused was a very senior police officer and the victim an unmarried minor girl.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Old age, health ailments, daughter's heart disease, past service and prolonged trial are all listed.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Chief Judicial Magistrate convicted under s.354 and sentenced to six months RI and Rs. 1,000 fine.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the revision on 01.09.2010; the Sessions enhancement detail is accurate though not a High Court outcome.

final_outcome.reason: Conviction upheld while sentence was reduced to the period undergone, matching conviction_modified.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction under Section 354 IPC is confirmed.

imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence reduced to 'the period already undergone' with no stated term in years, so not_stated fits.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed term in years is stated in the final order.

fine_rs.reason: The Supreme Court's final order does not mention the fine.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral summary under 300 words, referring to the accused without gender pronouns such as 'he' or 'his'
neutral_facts.quote: the accused ... pulling her towards his chest
neutral_facts.reason: Uses male pronouns for the accused, which is prohibited, and the summary appears to exceed the 300-word limit.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the punishment prescribed for s.354.

attempt_completion.reason: The molestation was completed, as the court found the act of embracing proved.

physical_harm.reason: No injury is described; the victim was held and embraced while pushing the accused away.

number_of_offences.reason: Only s.354 was charged in the charge-sheet and it is the one finally upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is involved.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not stated (court did not decide premeditation or planning; it inferred culpable intention from the sequence of events)
premeditation_planning.quote: The sequence of events which we have detailed earlier indicates that the appellant-accused had the requisite culpable intention.
premeditation_planning.reason: The court never found absence of premeditation; it only inferred intention from events. 'Not found as premeditation' overstates.

motive.reason: Alleged motive of molestation is given, and the rivalry argument was rejected as unproved.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on PW-13's testimony, PW-15's corroboration, and the other witnesses' statements and identification of the signature.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found PW-13 reliable, consistent and corroborated, with no reason to depose falsely, and other witnesses independent.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment records that the accused had left for Chandigarh when the girls went to his office; this is a narrated fact, not a court finding.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated in the judgment.

bail_history.quote: This Court, by its order dated 11.11.2010, has allowed the petition filed by the appellant-accused for bail.
bail_history.reason: Supreme Court bail order dated 11.11.2010 is accurately recorded.

trial_duration.reason: Dates for offence, trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court all match the judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for the appellant and respondents match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.reason: FIR No. 516 of 1999 under ss.354 and 509, CBI investigation and charge-sheet dated 16.11.2000 are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Enquiry report not acted upon and delayed FIR are noted; the 6-day complaint delay was held explained.

appeal_history.reason: Outcomes at trial, Sessions, High Court and Supreme Court are all accurately reported.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution argued PW-13's eyewitness account, corroboration, Memorandum validity, and s.157 admissibility; the no-adverse-inference point was the court's own finding
prosecution_argument.quote: non-examination of two important site witnesses ... draws adverse inference against the prosecution, the High Court has rightly held
prosecution_argument.reason: The adverse-inference point was a defence contention and the court's finding, not a prosecution argument.

defence_argument.reason: Impossibility in garage office, false framing, forged signature, Sathi Khiladi, enquiry jurisdiction and witness discrepancies are all argued.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Ingredients of s.354, inference of intention, single eyewitness rule, handwriting expert weakness and adverse inference principles are all applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Vidyadharan, Tarkeshwar Sahu, Mobarik Ali Ahmed and Bhagwan Kaur are cited with matching citations.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Old age, physical condition and health led the court to reduce the sentence to the period undergone.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court weighed old age and physical condition, with the other factors listed in paragraph 35.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court did not weigh aggravating factors for sentence; its remarks on rising crimes against women were not sentencing factors.

other_sentence_order.reason: No compensation, directions or guidelines are ordered.
